# HyperGain

> Full auto Hyperliquid trading bot — non-custodial, 24/7 automated perpetuals across 200+ markets.

HyperGain is automated trading software for Hyperliquid. Users deposit native USDC on Arbitrum One to their own Hyperliquid account (min. $5 on HL; $20+ to run the bot), approve a trading agent once, and run a full auto bot that scans markets 24/7. HyperGain never holds private keys or custodies funds. Returns are not guaranteed.

## Product summary

- **Product**: Full auto Hyperliquid trading bot + perps terminal
- **Custody**: Non-custodial — USDC stays on the user's Hyperliquid account
- **Funding**: Native USDC on Arbitrum One only (not BNB, BSC, or other chains)
- **Minimum**: $5 HL deposit · $20+ USDC to start the bot
- **Markets**: 200+ Hyperliquid perpetual pairs
- **Automation**: 24/7 server-side bot; user starts/stops via dashboard
- **Fees**: No monthly subscription; Hyperliquid fees apply; Platform Success Fee may apply on qualifying profitable closes (see Terms)
